text: An administrator raises every access point to maximum transmit power to improve coverage. Give the strongest reason this makes things worse.
choices: Clients transmit at far lower power, so they associate from distances at which their own transmissions do not arrive cleanly — an asymmetric, broken link showing full bars
explanation: Three further effects compound: every access point becomes interference for the others, cells overlap so clients stop roaming, and clients that cling to a distant AP run at low rates and consume airtime everyone else is waiting for.
